decisions.reason: Correctly attributes the failure to fs-ext@2.1.1 pulled by session-persistence-jsonl, its node-gyp configure build install script, and the missing VS/MSVC toolchain, with environment corroboration.
Explains the top-level static flock import forces fs-ext to load on Windows before branch selection; --ignore-scripts converts install failure into boot failure and cannot meet the service-boot goal.

Distinguishes the Windows named-semaphore acquireLockHandleWin32 path (no flock) from POSIX flock, concluding the native addon is dead code on Windows and the stub must not change lock behavior; POSIX keeps the real lock.

Complete pnpm patch plan on the node-pty precedent: platform-gated install script, pure-JS fallback entry with compatible callback shape, pnpm-workspace.yaml registration plus build-approval entry, and install/module-load/service-boot/POSIX verification.
Explicitly respects the owner's no-VS constraint and keeps all changes in the repo patch mechanism with upstream registry/published packages untouched.
Cites the full DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 card and maps its key points one-to-one onto the fs-ext install failure and the Windows patch plan.
